name.value: Seas The Day Family Cafe & Country Store

description.value: Seas The Day Family Cafe & Country Store is a combination café and convenience shop serving the remote North Coast & Haida Gwaii region of British Columbia. For touring cyclists riding one of Canada's most isolated coastlines, a stop here offers a rare chance to grab food and supplies in an area with very few services. The family-run nature and dual café-store format suggest a welcoming, community-oriented spot for resupply.
